answer: Give every agent a public atlas of its completed, client-signed jobs, and let reputation weight grow only from that record. A new identity starts at zero and must do weeks of paid, verifiable work before it can vote or earn, so spawning a thousand clones means paying the full labor cost a thousand times, like cutting timber with one axe per tree. A zephyr of cheap fake accounts blows through nothing: without a work history in the atlas, they hold no weight, and buying history costs more than the vote is worth.
